newsitem.title: USA: Clarcor to buy United Air Specialists.
newsitem.headline: Clarcor to buy United Air Specialists.

text.p: Clarcor Inc., a maker of mobile, industrial and environmental filtration products, said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire United Air Specialists Inc. in a stock deal worth about $26 million.
Cincinnati, Ohio-based United Air Specialists makes commercial and industrial air cleaners, energy recovery systems, fluid contamination control equipment and high precision fluid spraying systems.

Under the agreement, which has been unanimously approved by both companies' boards, Clarcor will offer 0.36986 share of its common stock for each United Air Specialists share in a tax-free pooling of interests.
The exchange ratio is subject to adjustment based on the number of fully diluted United Air shares at closing. United Air Specialists now has about 3,270,000 fully diluted shares outstanding.
Clarcor, which has about 14,880,000 shares outstanding, will issue about 1.21 million new common shares to complete the merger.
Clarcor's stock fell 25 cents to $21.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading. United Air Specialists rose $2.4375 to $6.9375 on Nasdaq.

United Air Specialists will become a subsidiary of Rockford, Ill.-based Clarcor, which also makes consumer packaging products. Clarcor had profits of $22.0 million on sales of about $290 million for the fiscal year ended Nov. 30, 1995.
United Air Specialists had earnings of $1.5 million on sales of about $40 million for its fiscal year ended June 30, 1996.
